patthana22.6:1.1: na kusalaṃ na noāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo
patthana22.6:2.1: noāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. nakusalattika nasāsavaduke kusalattika sāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.6:3.1: na kusalaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana22.6:5.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.6:6.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. nava. nakusalattika naāsavasāsavaduke kusalattika āsavasāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.6:7.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavañceva na anāsavañca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavoceva sāsavoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.6:8.1: na kusalaṃ na anāsavañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavoceva nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava. nakusalattika naāsavaāsavasampayuttaduke kusalattika āsavaāsavasammapayuttadukaṃ
patthana22.6:9.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavañceva na āsavavippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavoceva āsavasampayuttoca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.6:10.1: na kusalaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na nocaāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo āsavasampayuttoceva nocaāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. tīṇi. nakusalattika āsavavippayuttanasāsavaduke kusalattika āsavavippayuttasāsavadukaṃ
patthana22.6:11.1: na kusalaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato āsavavippayutto sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. nakusalattika sattagocchakaduke kusalattika sattagocchakadukaṃ
